name: ARDRONIS Locate RF DF system (Rohde & Schwarz)
description: Receive-only RF monitoring and direction finding on the control uplink, telemetry and video downlink. Locate Compact states more than 5 km. Warns while the drone is still on the ground. STANAG aligned and SAPIENT compliant.

detectRangeM.condition: more than 5000 m, no target class stated
detectRangeM.source: Rohde & Schwarz ARDRONIS Locate Compact solution page

classifyRangeM.condition: protocol identification range — R&S headline the family as 'Detection, classification and identification of drone and remote-control type' from one receive chain ('RF Receiver - reliable signal classification (20 MHz - 6 GHz)'), so classification is not a separate, shorter range. Set equal to detect. INFERRED.
classifyRangeM.source: Rohde & Schwarz ARDRONIS Detect page; JED counter-UAS survey table, May 2019
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m at INFERRED REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.condition: azimuth coverage — R&S: '360 deg coverage or sector coverage depending on the antenna'. 360 encodes the DF-antenna configuration (ADD207 compact UHF/SHF DF antenna, or ADD557SR covering 20 MHz - 6 GHz with one antenna). A sector-antenna build would need a smaller sectorDeg.

rangeAccuracyM.note: A single-site RF direction finder measures bearing, not range; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Class median of the sourced classification RF sensors: lib-titan 1, lib-rf360 5; median 3 deg. The R&S DDF550 direction finder ARDRONIS builds on is specified at 1° RMS (1.3 to 6 GHz, brochure v13), but the ARDRONIS-configured accuracy is not published.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Two-dimensional RF direction finding gives no elevation; not established by the public record.

receiverSensitivityDbm.note: Planning factor, 2.4 GHz band, channel-integrated: kTB for a 10 MHz OcuSync-class channel (-104 dBm) plus a 12 dB receiver noise figure (Narda SignalShark C-UAS application note, measured inherent noise across 0.5 to 3.7 GHz) gives -92 dBm, recorded as -90 dBm. R&S publishes the ADD557SR DF sensitivity only as a field strength (10 to 20 µV/m typ., 1 kHz bandwidth, 1 s integration, 2° RMS; ADD557SR brochure 3608-8534-12), which needs an antenna factor and a bandwidth scaling to reach dBm, so it is not recorded as L1. No passive RF sensor in the library publishes a sensitivity in dBm.

geolocationMinNodes.condition: angle-of-arrival direction finding on the ADD557SR correlative interferometer; R&S states location 'via automatic direction finding and triangulation'; two DF sites is the cross-bearing minimum
geolocationMinNodes.source: Rohde & Schwarz ARDRONIS brochure and datasheet page; ADD557SR brochure 3608-8534-12

rfBands.source: Rohde & Schwarz ARDRONIS Locate Compact solution page
